summary: Solid test suite covering core matrix generation logic, CLI contract, and workflow integration. Unit tests (matrix-generator.test.ts) comprehensively cover cartesianProduct, applyExclude, applyInclude, generateMatrix, and error conditions with clear TDD approach. CLI tests (cli.test.ts) validate file/stdin I/O and error messages. Workflow tests (workflow.test.ts) verify YAML structure, run actionlint, and execute three realistic scenarios end-to-end through `act` with exact value assertions. Strengths: well-organized, good fixture design, proper test isolation/cleanup, tests independent GitHub Actions semantics (override rules, standalone includes, etc.). Weaknesses: format-summary.ts lacks dedicated unit tests (only tested indirectly via workflow); CLI tests don't exercise complex configs with multiple flags/include/exclude; some numeric edge cases (maxMatrixSize=0, overflow) untested; one concern—no visibility into package.json test script configuration relative to 'deliberately kept out of bun run test' comment. Would catch most regressions in core logic but may miss edge cases in CLI handling or utility scripts.
